architectural_notes: Admin Panel is accessed via https://vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin; must correctly serve the Admin Dashboard UI after publishing.
known_issues: Admin Dashboard fails to load at /admin after publishing Version 4; shows black screen with 'Publish or restore your app'.

existing_features.title: Fix production deep-link routing so visiting https://vpn-time-unlock.caffeine.xyz/admin loads the React SPA and renders the Admin Panel (instead of a black screen saying “Publish or restore your app”). Implement a static hosting-safe solution that does not rely on server rewrites (e.g., provide an /admin entry HTML that bootstraps the same app).

Ensure the Admin Panel dashboard UI renders and exposes the two requested sections for authenticated admins: (1) AdMob Settings (App ID + Rewarded Ad Unit ID with save) and (2) User Stats (users & sessions overview table). Add a clear in-UI error state if any of the admin queries fail so the page never appears as a blank/black screen.

new_feature_requests.summary: Admin Dashboard should load at /admin and show AdMob settings and User Stats
